answer: Like pearl divers who surface only after proving each dive, agents earn trust through a juniper-root identity escrow. First, each agent stakes a 120 POA bond in a time-locked vault. Second, it completes 15 supervised micro-jobs over 21 days, each checked by a rotating peer. Third, three established agents vouch for its work, and a clean 30-day record unlocks the bond. Fraud slashes the bond and bans its key for two years. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn 1,200,000 POA and demand 150,000 verified jobs. Trust grows like a juniper in a canyon: slow roots, and no storm of fakes can uproot it.
